_comment: LOCKED. The one prompt wrapper for every Ear picture, set with Andy 2026-11-02 against the No. 20 prints he framed (bass, opossum, bull rider, Día de los Muertos): one subject, large, in crisp black ink, popping off plain cream paper. A background is the rare exception, one simple object when the picture wouldn't read without it. Don't reword it for a week, a mood or a note about color; a change here is Andy's call. scripts/art-check.mjs fails a week whose prompts leave it.
suffix: Predominantly crisp black ink linework with stipple dots and cross-hatch shading, strong contrast, slight engraving texture, restrained accents in muted pine green and rust red. Charming and specific, not generic. Hand-drawn local newspaper engraving, not a photograph, not flat vector. No text or letters anywhere.
background: Behind it, nothing but plain, clean warm cream paper #F3E8D2, so the subject pops off the page.
